name: nexgen-core
description: neXgen Core frontend monorepo — apps/admin (ADR-0005), apps/storefront (ADR-0006, Beta Milestone 1 foundation + Beta Milestone 2 customer experience), apps/store-api-gateway (STORE_API_GATEWAY_ARCHITECTURE.md — the Storefront's own BFF, standalone per the Product Owner's explicit Phase 4.1 direction), packages/* (ADR-0009, including packages/storefront-engine). apps/backend is the separate Laravel application and is not part of this workspace. CONSTRAINT: React is pinned to ^18.3 monorepo-wide (every apps/* and packages/* peer/devDependency) because @nexgen/ui ships raw .tsx source pinned to React 18 types with no build step of its own (packages/ui/COMPATIBILITY.md) — do not bump any single package's own React range independently; upgrade @nexgen/ui first.
